# Worker package descriptor


A worker is declared under the root `workers` map in `worker-compose.yaml`. The map key is its
identity. Run `iii compose validate --file worker-compose.yaml` to compile and validate the catalog.

The compiler reads the version from `source.package_manifest` and produces a normalized immutable
`PackageDescriptor`. Release and Registry tooling consume that descriptor and its canonical SHA-256
digest; runtime bundles do not contain or inspect the project Compose file.

See [Compose](../using-iii/compose#root-shape) for the complete root example and artifact variants.

## Required worker fields

| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `source.path` | Worker directory relative to the Compose root. |
| `source.package_manifest` | Package manifest relative to `source.path`; its version must be semver. |
| `artifact` | Strict tagged union: `rust-binary`, `javascript-bundle`, `python-bundle`, or `oci-image`. |
| `runtime` | Exact executable argv, digest-pinned base image where applicable, preparation argv, environment, and resources. |
| `registry` | Description, license, tags, dependencies, normalized defaults, and explicit `publish`. |
| `validation.interface` | `required` or `skipped`. |

Unknown fields fail. Source, manifest, toolchain, frontend, and include paths must remain inside the
Compose repository. Bundle includes are explicit file paths, never directories or globs. Secret-like
configuration values and reserved `III_*` environment keys are rejected.

`registry.config.defaults_file`, when present in Compose, is read at compile time. Its JSON object is
embedded as `registry.config.defaults` in the descriptor; the local path is not published as a
runtime contract.
